About Nepal Overview

MBBS in Nepal

In a nutshell, in the lap of the Himalayas, Nepal may be called small, yet stands as a beauteous south-Asian country, known as the land mass of Mount Everest, the supreme peak of Earth. It inherits cultural heritage coupled with striking natural beauty. Temples and monasteries, along with their natural surroundings, make popular spots in addition to serene calmness.

Kathmandu, the capital, is the center of culture and education in Nepal. The nation holds diverse ethnicities, languages, and customs. Nepali is the national language, although many people know and use English as a form of communication in different settings; hence, students from any nation find the environment friendly.

Nepal is also a country of warm and friendly people. Its proximity to India and similar food habits makes it a popular destination for Indian students.

All Requirements for MBBS in Nepal

Understand the essential criteria and requirements

Ensure your eligibility for pursuing MBBS and starting your medical journey.

Eligibility Criteria to Apply

To secure MBBS admission in Nepal, students must meet the following criteria:

  • Age should be 17 years by 31st December in Admission Year.
  • Must have completed 10+2 education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (Minimum 50%).
  • NEET should be qualified with General category marks.
  • MEC Nepal exam should be qualified (If the score is less than the maximum cutoff in NEET).

Required Documents & Intake

The main intake for MBBS in Nepal begins in September to November. Some universities may also offer additional admissions depending on seat availability.

Documents Needed:

  • 10th Mark sheet & 12th Mark sheet & Passing Certificate.
  • Aadhaar copy & NEET result.
  • 10 White Background Photographs with 70% Face (Size 3.5 X 4.5 CM).

Advantages of Studying MBBS in Nepal

MBBS in Nepal brings with itself some added advantages that most foreign students find beneficial. The curriculum of Nepalese medical colleges closely aligns with Indian medical standards.

Campus Life & Living Expenses

Cost of Living About 10,000 to 15,000 INR per month.

Medical students in Nepal enjoy a comfortable and friendly campus environment, especially Indian students who find the culture and lifestyle quite similar to India. Colleges offer modern classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, digital libraries, and simulation centers.

Hostels provide safe accommodation with Indian food options, making it easy for students to adjust. Students participate in clinical workshops, seminars, community health camps, cultural events, and sports activities throughout the year.

Pathway Particulars

Duration & Structure

The duration of the MBBS course in Nepal is 5.5 years, which includes 4.5 years of academic study followed by a 1-year compulsory internship in affiliated hospitals.

Medium of Teaching

The medium of teaching for MBBS in Nepal is English, making it easy for Indian students to understand the curriculum and communicate effectively during clinical training.

MBBS Admission In Nepal

A step-by-step roadmap to admission

The admission process is straightforward and designed to accommodate national and international students.

  1. Fill out the application form: Fill out the admission form from the RMC website.
  2. Select your University: Select your NMC-approved desired university to study MBBS.
  3. Submit Documents: Submit scanned documents: 10th and 12th mark sheets, NEET score card, copy of the medical certificate, and passport.
  4. Receive Invitation: After 10-15 days of applying, you’ll get the invitation letter from the university.
  5. Apply for Visa: Students can apply for a visa in the respective embassy for 10 days of visa processing.

Scholarships for MBBS in Nepal

Besides government policies for scholarships, numerous private scholarships favor this field.

  • Merit-Based Scholarships: Awarded to students with outstanding academic achievements.
  • Need-Based Scholarships: Given to students belonging to economically weaker sections showing potential.
  • North-South Foundation Scholarship: Available specifically for studying medicine in Nepal, for Indian students.

Career Opportunities After MBBS

Completing an MBBS from Nepal opens multiple career paths for Indian students.

  • Practice in India: Graduates can return to India and appear for the FMGE/NExT exam to practice medicine.
  • Higher Studies: Pursue higher studies like MD/MS in India, Nepal, or other countries.
  • Global Careers: Apply for USMLE, PLAB, or other international licensing exams.
  • Diverse Roles: Choose clinical practice, hospital jobs, research, teaching, or work in NGOs.
MBBS in Nepal Syllabus

Comprehensive medical curriculum

Here is a breakdown of the syllabus year by year.

1st Year

Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry.

2nd Year

Pharmacology, Pathology, Microbiology, Community Medicine.

3rd Year

Forensic Medicine, Ophthalmology, ENT, Community Medicine (continued).

4th Year

Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics, Gynecology, Orthopedics, Dermatology, Psychiatry.

Internship

Clinical Rotations in all major departments.

Comparing MBBS in Nepal Vs MBBS in India

Side-by-side decision matrix

01

MBBS in India

  • Tuition Fees: Government colleges: 11-25 lakh INR; Private colleges: 50 lakh–1 crore INR.
  • Seat Availability: Highly competitive, over 20 lakh students attempt NEET each year.
  • Medium of Instruction: Most courses in English, though some colleges use regional languages.
  • Living Costs: Varies, upwards from 12,000–25,000 INR per month.
02

MBBS in Nepal

  • Tuition Fees: The entire course would cost between 46-60 lakh INR.
  • Seat Availability: Less competition due to fewer applicants and open-border policies.
  • Medium of Instruction: Courses are taught in English, making it relevant to international students.
  • Living Costs: Affordable, within a range of 10,000–15,000 INR per month.
